verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a single dependency-free binary you can run on any Linux, macOS or Windows machine, bare metal or containers. Official Docker images and Helm charts mean you can place your data on any infrastructure you control. Hands-on reports confirm self-hosting on chosen providers like Hetzner, and a community tester notes Meilisearch Cloud offers a set of regions, though there is no Australian one (Singapore is closest). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Cloud region selection and data-residency guarantees, broader cloud region coverage (e.g. Australia).
